interactions.name: Primary input
interactions.trigger: Pointer activation of the demonstrated primary control
interactions.response: The product advances from the entry surface into the task
interactions.cancellation: Move away without activating the control
interactions.failure: No activation leaves the entry state unchanged
interactions.recovery: Return to the visible control and activate it

interactions.name: Focus and selection
interactions.trigger: Select the demonstrated item, field, or workspace target
interactions.response: The target becomes the active context
interactions.feedback: Selection styling or an active detail surface is visible
interactions.failure: An unselected target does not advance the workflow

interactions.name: Navigation
interactions.response: The central product surface changes while application context remains
interactions.feedback: Destination content replaces the prior surface
interactions.failure: A wrong destination shows content unrelated to the goal
interactions.recovery: Navigate back to the demonstrated destination

interactions.name: Configuration
interactions.trigger: Enter or choose the demonstrated task parameters
interactions.response: The product reflects the configured values
interactions.feedback: The in-progress state exposes the chosen configuration
interactions.cancellation: Remove or replace the current choice
interactions.failure: An incomplete configuration cannot produce the shown result

interactions.name: Confirmation
interactions.trigger: Activate the demonstrated commit, create, run, send, or save action
interactions.feedback: The surface transitions toward the result
interactions.cancellation: Back out before the commit action
interactions.failure: Committing with the task incomplete leaves a no-result state
interactions.recovery: Complete the required context and confirm again

interactions.name: Backtracking
interactions.trigger: Return from the current detail or configuration surface
interactions.response: The previous product context is restored
interactions.failure: Leaving too early abandons the pending result
interactions.recovery: Re-enter the demonstrated task from the restored context

interactions.name: System feedback
interactions.trigger: Wait after the demonstrated committed action
interactions.response: The first meaningful result becomes visible
interactions.feedback: Result content replaces or augments the in-progress state
interactions.cancellation: No cancellation is shown after completion
interactions.failure: Stopping before feedback provides no completion evidence
interactions.recovery: Wait for the visible result state

interactions.name: Failure and recovery
interactions.trigger: Attempt to proceed without the demonstrated selection or context
interactions.response: The workflow remains incomplete rather than reaching the result
interactions.feedback: The expected result state is absent
interactions.cancellation: Return to the preceding stable surface
interactions.recovery: Restore the demonstrated context and repeat the confirmed action

failure_route: Without the demonstrated context or selection, the workflow remains before the result state.

motion_analysis.trigger: Nothing the viewer does: the clip is an official screen recording that plays itself. Inside it a drawn white pointer does the work — it opens each "Select" dropdown in the Welcome to Intercom modal (first at ~18s, department at ~36s, role at ~42s), reaches "Save and continue" at 48.0s and presses it by 49.0s, then travels down the collapsed Inbox rail from Fin AI Agent to Knowledge between 86s and 89s.
motion_analysis.start_state: A Gmail message "Phil has invited you to work together on Intercom" with a "Join your team" button (0-0.25s), which crossfades to the "Join your team on Intercom" signup page carrying Sign Up with Google, Your name, Work email and "Password (at least 15 characters)" fields.
motion_analysis.end_state: The Intercom Messenger home panel "Hi, Sara! How can we help?" listing "Let's have a conversation", "Send us a message", "Order status" and a "Find an answer quickly" search field, beside the zoomed Inbox rail (89.5-90.0s).
motion_analysis.continuity: One 90.00s render at 30 fps (2700 counted frames). Motion inside a scene is continuous — the pointer travels, dropdown menus expand in place, and across 46.0-48.75s the four modal answers stay on screen while the cursor moves down to the Save and continue button — and scenes are joined by short dissolves rather than hard cuts: the signup page dims behind a light outline around the Sign Up with Google block at ~2.5-3.75s, and the modal dissolves through a "We'll be right with you..." interstitial at 49.25s into the "Join your team on Inbox" page at 49.5s. No still-image interpolation.
motion_analysis.feedback: Every action draws a visible answer in the same frame: each chosen dropdown value replaces the placeholder word "Select" in the modal (three answers standing at 45.0s, all four including "Support Rep" by 47.0s), the Save and continue button darkens under the pointer at 48.5-49.0s, a "We'll be right with you..." line covers the wait at 49.25s, and the Inbox counters report the outcome as numerals (Your inbox 0, Created by you 3, header "0 Open") at 75.6s.

observations: Every destination in media/state-03-result.jpg is written out as text beside its icon — Inbox, Fin AI Agent, Knowledge, Reports, Outbound, Contacts in the rail and Your inbox, Mentions, Created by you, All, Unassigned, Spam, Dashboard in the list — so nothing in the navigation is icon-only.

Conversation volume is carried by numerals rather than by motion: Your inbox 0, Mentions 0, Created by you 3, All 0, Unassigned 0, Spam 0 and the "0 Open" list header all read from the still frame (media/state-03-result.jpg, 75.6s).

Each answered onboarding question replaces the placeholder word "Select" with the chosen text ("I've used other support solutions but not Intercom", "Support customers", "Customer Support/Service"), so progress through the form stays legible with the animation stopped (media/state-02-progress.jpg, 45.0s).

In the rail-and-list crop of media/state-03-result.jpg (x 0-230, y 60-330) the brightest 2% of pixels (255,255,255) against the darkest 2% (28,29,23) measure a 16.97:1 luminance contrast ratio and the conversation-list crop (x 250-520, y 60-320) measures 8.39:1 for (79,77,78) on white, while the modal body crop of media/state-01-entry.jpg (x 228-420, y 55-300) measures only 4.81:1 for its grey (114,114,114) question text on white. All computed with the WCAG relative-luminance formula over the retained JPEGs.

The signup step marks emphasis without relying on movement alone: from ~2.5s to 3.75s the page behind the "Sign Up with Google" block is dimmed and the block is drawn inside a light outline, and the password field states its rule as visible text ("Password (at least 15 characters)").
unknowns: Screen-reader names, roles, and live-region announcements were not exposed by the static-source recording.
Complete keyboard traversal and focus order were not established by the recording.
Reduced-motion preference handling and a nonanimated equivalent were not demonstrated.

evidence_gaps: accessibility never measured against the product
